patch.old:
- name: status
        type: categorical
    measures:
      - name: revenue
        description: "Quantity x price charged."
patch.new:
- name: status
        type: categorical
      - name: unit_price
        type: categorical
        expr: unit_price
    measures:
      - name: revenue
        description: "Quantity x price charged."

patch.text:
- name: premium_completed_revenue
    description: "Completed revenue on lines with unit price at least 100."
    label: "Premium completed revenue"
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: revenue
    filter: "{{ Dimension('sales__status') }} = 'completed' AND {{ Dimension('sales__unit_price') }} >= 100"

note: harmless alternative: expose unit_price as a dimension and define a metric with >= 100
